mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge_order (id, user_id, plan_id, gold_amount, bonus_amount, price_twd, status, payment_method, gateway_provider, gateway_order_id, gateway_result, gateway_ret_msg, virtual_account, payment_info, limit_date, gateway_raw_resp, paid_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{goldAmount}, #{bonusAmount}, #{priceTwd}, #{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{paymentMethod}, #{gatewayProvider}, #{gatewayOrderId}, #{gatewayResult}, #{gatewayRetMsg}, #{virtualAccount}, #{paymentInfo}, #{limitDate}, #{gatewayRawResp}, #{paidAt}, #{expiredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recharge_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recharge_order SET status = #{newStatus,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, gateway_order_id = #{gatewayOrderId}, gateway_raw_resp = #{gatewayRawResp}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}
UPDATE recharge_order SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at < #{now}

UPDATE recharge_order SET gateway_provider = #{gatewayProvider}, gateway_order_id = #{gatewayOrderId}, gateway_result = #{gatewayResult}, gateway_ret_msg = #{gatewayRetMsg}, virtual_account = #{virtualAccount}, payment_info = #{paymentInfo}, limit_date = #{limitDate}, gateway_raw_resp = #{gatewayRawResp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
